text:
omar (PM): Heads-up - need a quick sync on VPC/on-prem pricing and the field sprint priorities. Customers are pushing for clearer upgrade guarantees and a pricing slab for private infra.

linda (Product): Short context: two enterprise trials requesting predictable monthly pricing + documented upgrade downtime. Also several smaller customers asking for per-instance billing.

kevin (Eng): For upgrades we can offer a rolling operator path (minimal downtime) vs full-redeploy. Rolling requires extra e2e tests and canary automation.

sarah (Solutions): From field: biggest blocker is 'network handoff' - customers want a simple checklist they can give to their NetOps.

jessica (Sales): Sales feedback - if we can promise <=1hr P0 rollback window and a price tier for dedicated single-tenant installs, we close 3 deals this quarter.

omar (PM): Proposal idea: two SKUs for Private: "Managed Handshake" (customer network + Redwood operator) and "Airgapped Self-Admin" (on-prem, support contract). Pricing bands by GPUs and retention.

linda (Product): Agree. Also include an "Upgrade SLA" add-on: weekly patch windows + paid emergency upgrade.

kevin (Eng): Implementation rough plan:
Sprint A (3 weeks): packaging baseline, airgap installer testing, docs
Sprint B (3 weeks): VPC peering helpers, ip-preserve mode, NetOps checklist generator
Sprint C (2 weeks): upgrade operator + automated canary rollouts + rollback playbook
Sprint D (2 weeks): e2e field validation + internal runbook + train-the-trainer

sarah (Solutions): We should also ship a one-page "Network Handoff" that lists ports, CIDR, firewall rules, and a preflight script snippet customers can run.

jessica (Sales): Can the preflight script be non-root friendly? Some customers refuse scripts that need cluster-admin.

kevin (Eng): We'll offer two preflight modes: light (read-only checks, no elevated perms) and deep (optional, for full install validation).

omar (PM): Decision point for roadmap: do we prioritize Upgrade SLA or Per-instance pricing band first? Need to align on revenue impact.

jessica (Sales): Revenue-first - prioritize Per-instance pricing band. We can start quoting immediately with a conservative SLA.

linda (Product): Product risk-first - Upgrade SLA reduces churn. My vote SLA first, then pricing band.

kevin (Eng): From capacity perspective SLA requires extra automation but not a huge engineering lift if we scope canary to 10% traffic. Pricing band is legal/finance work.

omar (PM): Compromise - split scope across teams. Roadmap callouts:
- Q1: Ship packaging baseline + Per-instance pricing proposal (docs + quoting template)
- Q2: Upgrade SLA pilot with two customers, canary operator + rollback
- Q2+: NetOps checklist generator and preflight light mode per sprint B

sarah (Solutions): I'll prepare the one-pager and an internal FAQ for NetOps by end of next week.

jessica (Sales): I'll validate price bands with finance and share mock quotes by Tue.

kevin (Eng): I'll allocate eng cycles: sprint A starts Monday, will tag owners in the tracker.

omar (PM): Action items: @sarah produce handoff doc, @jessica price bands, @kevin start sprint A, @linda draft SLA MVP. We'll reconvene Friday 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:
